summary_en: This Phase 1a/1b study tests RSC-1255, alone or with hydroxychloroquine, in adults with advanced solid tumors such as lung, colon, pancreatic cancer, and glioblastoma. The study drug is taken by mouth twice a day in 21-day cycles, and Phase 1a enrolls 40-80 participants while Phase 1b enrolls 48-94. The main aims are to find the dose-limiting toxicity and recommended dose in Phase 1a, and to study safety, pharmacology, and clinical efficacy in Phase 1b.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1a/1b evalúa RSC-1255, solo o con hidroxicloroquina, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados como cáncer de pulmón, de colon, de páncreas y glioblastoma. El medicamento del estudio se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en ciclos de 21 días; la fase 1a incluye de 40 a 80 participantes y la fase 1b de 48 a 94. Los objetivos principales son identificar la toxicidad limitante de dosis y la dosis recomendada en la fase 1a, y estudiar la seguridad, la farmacología y la eficacia clínica en la fase 1b.
who_for: Pathology-confirmed advanced or metastatic cancer that is intolerant of, refractory to, or has progressed on standard therapy.
Has measurable or evaluable tumor(s) on standard scans or lab tests.
Is 18 years of age or older.
Has a solid tumor with documented RAS mutation, or glioblastoma with or without RAS mutation.
not_for: Currently receiving cancer therapy at enrollment.
Clinically significant disease affecting a major organ system, significant heart disease, or ECG abnormalities.
Known Gilbert's disease or intermittent low potassium (hypokalemia).
Current or prior (within 2 years) malignancy other than the target cancer.
Grade 1 or higher nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea at baseline due to the underlying disease.
